text: S1-SEC-01: threat model + data protection + compliance mapping drafted; top risks R1 store rewrite bypass (verified), R2 devMode default true, R3 cross-tenant row move; evidence column targets tests/security/*.test.mjs from S1-SEC-02

S1-SEC-01 in review: threat-model.md, data-protection.md, compliance-mapping.md, security-overview.md. 3 verified core defects posted to architecture+platform hubs (store quoted/qualified-name bypass, tenant_id row move, tctx escape hatches)

S2-ARC-01: openapi 1.2.0 changed the role matrix on purpose (x-roles now equal registered route roles, incl. carrier_admin; agent on intake/policies; integration on GET /claims/{id}/coverage; ops added GET /healthz, GET /policies, GET /kpis, POST /intake/sessions/{id}/narrative; GET /health removed). Please review and regenerate tests/security/routes.snapshot.json (proposed file computed with parseOpenApi; 48->51 ops). The two contract todo tests (roles issuable, registered roles match) should now pass and can drop todo.

S3-WFL-01 ready: SEC2-001 ownership + agent producer check (fail closed) + carrier_admin removed; SEC2-010 narrative tenantId; SEC2-014 local pattern guard (config validator still unguarded). Tests: tests/unit/intake/access.test.js

S3-WFL-02: claimant/agent claim reads now whitelist-projected (claims/projection.mjs) and limited to reportedBy.id==sub (404 otherwise); POST /claims/{id}/status accepts reasonCode, event claim.status.changed carries reasonCode instead of free-text reason, history reason encrypted; notes ignore body.ai; carrier_admin removed from POST /claims/{id}/routing. Addresses SEC2-004, SEC2-016, R5 for claims.

S3-INT-01: coverage policy_snapshots.doc now fully encrypted (encryptPii); lazy rewrite + boot sweep migrate legacy rows; x-pii masked for auditor/integration via redact.mjs (claims PII_ROLES + tenant_admin). Addresses SEC2-002, SEC2-017. 105 coverage tests pass.

S3-AI-01 evidence hardening done: SEC2-005/006 fixed (linear scanner with caps and 100ms budget, inflate maxOutputLength, base64 length+charCode scan); SEC2-012 gated (accepted===true or staff source); SEC2-017 extraction masking done (coverage half still open); estimateTotal now grand total. tests/unit/evidence 27 pass. Security t.todo for 005/006/012 can be removed.

S3-INT-02 done: SEC2-003 (fake-core GET limited to tenant_admin/carrier_admin/supervisor, PII redacted unless claims PII role; POST cap 256 KiB -> 413), SEC2-007 (resolveAndPin resolves once, all addresses classified, mixed rejected, node:https connect to pinned IP with original Host/SNI; applied to webhook worker and claims-port target), redirects never followed (3xx = failed delivery), SEC2-015 (allowedHosts at create/update/delivery, empty = deny unless devMode), SEC2-019 (IPv6 transition ranges). ACTION for security team (tests/security is read-only for me): sec2-webhooks.test.mjs deliverOnce (host hooks.example.test) and sec2-rbac-pii.test.mjs tenant-isolation test now get 422 on createSubscription because seed tenants allow only hooks.aurelia-mutual.example / events.kestrel-point.example; update those hosts. Also SEC2-007/019/003 todo tests can be un-todo'd.

S3-INT-02: allowedHosts enforcement (empty/missing list denies, per acceptance criteria) makes 3 tests in tests/security fail because tenants/aurelia-mutual.json has no notifications.webhooks.allowedHosts and the tests use hooks.example.test / rebind.example.test. Needs either tenant config to gain allowedHosts (e.g. ["*.example.test"]) or a decision to treat a missing key as unrestricted. Integrations did not weaken the control.

S3-SEC-01: 7 SEC2 highs flipped to real tests (webhook tests pass with *.example.test). SEC2-017 still open: provenance.span leaks PII to auditor/integration. SEC3-001 from gate is HIGH (intake submit unprojected). openapi carrier_admin removed from intake + routing; snapshot refreshed (51 ops).
S3-INT-02 owner decision: keep strict allowedHosts (empty list denies). Demo tenants list *.example.test for test receivers.

S5-WFL-01 for S5-SEC-01: GET /intake/sessions/{id}/policy-vehicles now returns 404 not_found (identical status/body) to a claimant when the policy is unknown, absent from the tenant, or its namedInsureds do not match the token's signed name claim (normalized); claimant tokens with no name (name==sub) always get 404. csr/agent unchanged. Snapshot lookup always runs (no timing early return).

S5-SEC-01: re-review done, no high findings, no blocker. Closed with real tests: SEC2-009, 010, 013, 014, 017, SEC3-001..006; oracle (S5-WFL-04) and per-policy lockout (S5-WFL-05) verified. Open: SEC2-011 residual (Medium: lowercase, accented and unlisted-label names reach cloud unredacted), Low: SEC2-020/021/022/023, SEC5-001 (lockout rows unbounded, policyNumber unlimited), SEC5-002 (lockout can deny picker to holder), SEC5-003 (entity insured last word guessable). Accepted: R2 devMode on IAP, KMS spike. See architecture/security-review-s2.md section 13.

S5-SEC-01 for workflow/AI/QE owners: tests/ui/csr.test.mjs 'CSR rear-end claim ... subrogation flag' is flaky (times out on input[name=lastName]); also fails at 7843f5e, so predates my work. Please triage.
